pages.text: $(bold)Jacob's Ladder$(): a stairway to heaven — and a pillar of judgment.$(br2)Aim at a target within 16 blocks and summon a large magic circle marked with a $(bold)heptagram and a cross$() $(bold)10 blocks above the target's head$(); after a $(bold)2-second charge$(), a colossal pillar of light descends.$(br2)$(bold)Circle radius$() = (1 + (Affinity/10 + Output)/10) × Output × 5 blocks$(br2)$(bold)Pillar's base per-frame damage$() = (1 + (Affinity/10 + Output)/10) × (Output × 8 + player damage) × 0.1

$(bold)Targets bathed in the pillar of light$():$(li)their techniques and domains are $(bold)disabled for 60 seconds$() — $(l:techniques/wuliang_wuxian)Limitless: Infinity$() and other $(bold)sustained cursed techniques are terminated instantly$() (domains are forcibly closed, an active Black Bird is recalled)$(li)they keep taking $(bold)per-frame damage$(): once every 2 ticks, $(bold)ignoring invulnerability frames$()$(li)$(bold)undead creatures$() take $(bold)8×$() the per-frame damage$(br2)Its cursed energy cost is $(bold)8×$() that of Dismantle. Uses up a technique slot.
